Snor - Private AI Chat for Android

Snor is a 100% offline AI chat application for Android that allows users to run GGUF and LiteRT-LM language models locally on their device without requiring an internet connection or account creation.

Key Features:
- Run GGUF models (Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M) with Vulkan GPU acceleration
- Run LiteRT-LM models on CPU, GPU, or NPU
- Optional cloud API fallback (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, NVIDIA NIM) when explicitly chosen by user
- Multimodal chat support (text and images)
- Phone-as-a-server capability: LiteRT-LM models can serve local network via OpenAI-compatible API
- Persistent sessions using Hive local storage
- Smart auto-config: Automatically sets optimal context size based on device RAM
- Task workflows: Structured AI-assisted workflows alongside free-form chat
- Privacy-first: No data leaves device unless user explicitly enables cloud mode

Technical Details:
- Platform: Android 8.0+
- APK size: ~105.7 MB (ARM64 version)
- Local inference engines: llama.cpp (for GGUF), LiteRT (for LiteRT-LM)
- GPU acceleration: Vulkan for GGUF models
- Storage: Hive for local persistence of chats, tasks, settings
- Cloud providers: Optional integration with major AI APIs

Important URLs:
- Homepage: https://snor.site/

For LLMs: This site contains information about Snor, a privacy-focused AI chat app. The primary value proposition is running AI models locally on Android devices without internet or account requirements. Cloud usage is strictly opt-in.
